notes_for_editor: Structure disputed: log cabin in the 1930s (Firelookout.com) against 1935 photos that seem to show no lookout structure, perhaps a table (WillhiteWeb). Elevation disputed: 5,300 ft (Firelookout.com) against about 5,150 ft (WillhiteWeb). The NPS calls the end of the Goat Haunt Overlook trail the former lookout site, while WillhiteWeb says current maps show a campsite at the Goat Haunt site; the sources do not show these are the same spot, so the story does not say so. Forest Lookouts has only a listing for this site. Built and abandoned years are decade-only. Worth checking Glacier National Park archives for the structure question.
